Leyland Trade Super Leytex is a high-opacity matt emulsion paint designed for interior walls and ceilings. This water-based paint is ideal for trade professionals working on new plaster, providing a highly permeable film that allows fresh surfaces to breathe and dry out naturally. It is perfect for fast-paced commercial and residential renovation projects. The paint offers a coverage of 13m²/Ltr, saving time and material costs. It becomes touch-dry in 1 to 2 hours and is ready for a second coat in 2 to 4 hours, ensuring rapid project turnaround times.
